spanish: y sus columnas cinco y sus ganchos, y chapó sus cabezas y sus fajas de oro, y sus basas cinco de bronce.

findings.issue: «sus» smooths the 3ms suffix on the columns and the 3mp suffixes on the hooks, heads, bands, and bases into one possessive; possessor number is not marked.

notes: DOM את is untranslated; chapó matches piel perfect 3ms; five, gold, and bronze stay in place.
